view.title: C3c — Component overlay: provenance & pinning
view.caption: Who writes lineage, carrying what? A subset of C3a — the thirteen lineage writers, Preserve Provenance, and the two store edges. The thirteen edges are directed and unlabeled; they share the one meaning fixed in the key (§0).

nodes.label: Preserve Provenance
detail: Append-only hash-chained lineage, CA=13 (ADR 0012); + metrics read model + auditor export (ADR 0008, CF11)

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
detail: WORKING ASSUMPTION (spine C3); lineage schema append-only: app role INSERT/SELECT only, per-conversion hash chain, supersede-not-update — ADR 0012

nodes.label: object storage
detail: Evidence object storage behind an S3-compatible port (ADR 0011). Lineage chain anchors (ADR 0012)
